# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Security Log Monitoring

Warns in the System log as soon as the Security log is 90% full and logs pipeline execution of all PowerShell modules, so that during an incident the log has not been overwritten unnoticed and PowerShell activity is fully traceable.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | CIS v4 Windows 11 L1 (MSS WarningLevel, IntuneAdmin CISv4 profile) and the Microsoft recommendation for PowerShell logging ('PowerShell ♥ the Blue Team') — values verified against the settings catalog definitions |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Security_Log_Monitoring.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Security_Log_Monitoring.json) |

> No overlap: `turnonpowershellscriptblocklogging` (Security Hardening) and `enabletranscripting` (Logging) are different ids. The size of the PowerShell/Operational log cannot be set through the settings catalog — there is a remediation for that in IntuneTemplate/WIN/Remediations/event-log-sizes.
